name: Trades-Runtime
title: Trades-Runtime
author: Aziel Eliab
one_line: Shadow-first AI operating system and company operating intelligence layer for large multi-branch HVAC, plumbing, electrical, sewer, and cross-trades field service.
honesty: This JSON is a static design catalog for a private Pages portal. Engines, fabrics, pipelines, and ops are design/stub. No live Worker backends, DOIs, or production APIs are claimed.

design_target.note: Design target and operating context, not a live deployment claim.

integration.posture: Tether to ServiceTitan + ProBooks / authorized systems first. Read-only or recommendation until evidence supports greater autonomy.

principles.name: Shadow-first
principles.summary: Observe, produce a sealed counterfactual, compare to actual outcomes. Do not start by replacing ServiceTitan or ProBooks.

principles.name: Human Authority Rule
principles.summary: Authorized human decisions always win operationally. Disagreements are preserved as evidence, never erased.

principles.name: One canonical live state
principles.summary: Every role view is generated from the same company state. Reality is the next starting point after every event.

principles.name: Reconstructable receipts
principles.summary: Material recommendations must be explainable after the fact from contemporaneous evidence.

is_not: Not a leaderboard that equates revenue with technician quality.
Not a fixed morning route planner.
Not an autonomous black box that can silently overrule humans.
Not an AI that treats a photo inference as proof of fault or misconduct.
Not a fuel-minimization system that sacrifices technical fit or customer outcome.
Not a system that assumes a 30-day return visit is automatically a technician callback.
Not a public Softwares suite or FragGate engine catalog.
Not a live Worker backend in this repository.

authority.note: v0.1 is a static architecture portal. Planned ops and engines are named, not executed.

deployment_ladder.name: Observe
deployment_ladder.summary: Ingest and normalize data without influencing decisions.

deployment_ladder.name: Shadow
deployment_ladder.summary: Produce sealed counterfactual recommendations while humans and existing software operate normally.

deployment_ladder.name: Recommend
deployment_ladder.summary: Surface decisions to staff with no autonomous execution.

deployment_ladder.name: Limited Autonomy
deployment_ladder.summary: Narrowly scoped actions with hard constraints and rollback.

deployment_ladder.name: Autonomous Operations
deployment_ladder.summary: Only after sustained evidence, governance, and operational approval.

modes.name: Watcher
modes.summary: Analytics/operating mode for observe-only ingest. Corresponds to the Observe rung on the deployment ladder.

modes.name: Recommendation
modes.summary: Decisions are shown to authorized humans; nothing executes itself.

modes.name: Human-Approved
modes.summary: Action proceeds only after an authorized human accepts.

modes.name: Autonomous
modes.summary: Not claimed. Requires sustained proof and explicit governance.

chains.name: Full-Day Trajectory
chains.purpose: Tracks the day as an evolving system.
chains.preserves: Morning plan, each real-world state change, each rebase, schedule displacement, route drift, end-of-day result.

chains.name: Call-to-Call Ledger
chains.preserves: Assignment, travel, arrival, media, diagnosis, parts, quote, repair/turnover, runtime, customer outcome, next-state effect.

chains.name: Human Override / Recalibration
chains.preserves: Original Trades recommendation, role/person who changed it, timestamp, stated reason, replacement decision, downstream effect, final outcome.

chains.name: Chain D coordination / handoff
chains.purpose: Reconstruct cross-function handoffs so a failed acknowledgment is not mislabeled as a dispatcher or technician fault.

history_rule: Never overwrite history. Planned state, actual state, counterfactual state, and human override state remain separately queryable. A rebase changes the next decision; it does not erase the prior decision.

fabrics.name: Decision Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Reconciles candidate outputs: evidence weighting, cross-pipeline agreement/disagreement, hard-constraint validation, uncertainty, ranked action set. No single pipeline controls operations.

fabrics.name: Real-Time Operations Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Seconds/minutes: booking, dispatch, call-ins, emergencies, Van state, route rebase, employee windows.

fabrics.name: Planning Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Hours/days/weeks: staffing, PTO impact, maintenance capacity, protected reserve, branch borrowing.

fabrics.name: Economic Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Labor × cost × profit, contribution, margin, opportunity cost, pricing, procurement, warranty recovery.

fabrics.name: Evidence Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Receipts, provenance, media, hashes, source conflict, point-in-time truth, reconstructability.

fabrics.name: Learning Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Model training, calibration, historical replay, skill learning, demand learning, drift detection.

fabrics.name: Simulation Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Counterfactual schedules, branch scenarios, no-impact synthetic operating runs.

fabrics.name: Analytics Fabric
fabrics.responsibility: Arbitrary reports, graphs, models, scales, probabilities, and human-review queries.

pipelines.name: Deterministic Rules Pipeline
pipelines.role: Hard constraints, safety, qualification, SLA, policy, non-negotiable rules.

pipelines.name: Optimization Pipeline
pipelines.role: Dispatch, routing, capacity allocation, scheduling, contribution, schedule-survival.

pipelines.name: Predictive ML Pipeline
pipelines.role: Demand, duration, callback, inventory, conversion, urgency, capacity probabilities.

pipelines.name: Simulation / Digital-Twin Pipeline
pipelines.role: Counterfactual schedules, scenario testing, alternative operational futures.

pipelines.name: LLM Reasoning Pipeline
pipelines.role: Unstructured notes, context synthesis, explanation, root-cause hypotheses, solution generation.

pipelines.name: Historical Analogue Pipeline
pipelines.role: Comparable past calls/days/branches as empirical decision evidence.

pipelines.name: Cross-Branch / Federated Pipeline
pipelines.role: Company-wide balancing of Vans, labor, inventory, booking capacity, regional support.

pipelines.name: Human-Heuristic Pipeline
pipelines.role: Learn recurring dispatcher/manager override patterns without assuming the human is always correct.

decisioning.pareto_frontier: For material decisions, expose plans where improving one objective necessarily worsens another. Recommend one; keep alternatives visible.
decisioning.champion_challenger: Challengers remain in Shadow until settlement against actual outcomes justifies promotion. Preserve rollback and version lineage.

engines.name: Booking & Call Intake Engine
engines.summary: Shared visibility into membership, equipment, warranty, and service history at booking.

engines.name: Dispatch / Call-Fit Engine
engines.summary: Multi-objective Call-Fit. Geography is never the final factor.

engines.name: Full-Day Trajectory Engine
engines.summary: Morning plan, event, rebase from actual state, close.

engines.name: Runtime Prediction Engine
engines.summary: Duration as a distribution, not a fixed block.

engines.name: Technician Skill & Exploration Engine
engines.summary: Competence-gated exploration so assignment history does not poison skill.

engines.name: Visual/Video QA Engine
engines.summary: Media as calibration evidence. Inference alone is never proof of misconduct.

engines.name: Warranty & Callback Classifier
engines.summary: 30-day returns are review triggers, not automatic penalties.

engines.name: Manager Intervention Predictor
engines.summary: Prioritized recommendation queue. Does not remove field/office judgment.

engines.name: Pricebook / Quote / Margin Engine
engines.summary: ServiceTitan pricebook as shadow baseline. Humans ACCEPT, OVERRIDE, or LOCK.

engines.name: Inventory Prediction Engine
engines.summary: Van-specific stock vs predicted need vs actual consumption.

engines.name: Revenue & Turnover Attribution Engine
engines.summary: Keep the originating service call connected to downstream outcomes.

engines.name: Counterfactual Outcome Engine
engines.summary: What Trades would have done from information available at that moment only.

engines.name: Receipt / Audit / Override Engine
engines.summary: Reconstructable evidence packets for material recommendations.

engines.name: Workforce Capacity & Availability Engine
engines.summary: Schedule against the workforce that actually exists (addendum v0.8).

engines.name: Universal Analytics & Human Review
engines.summary: If Trades has the authorized data, a human can interrogate it (addendum v0.7).

engines.name: Decision Fabric reconciler
engines.summary: Cross-pipeline coherence, Pareto frontier, champion/challenger (addendum v0.9).

planned_ops.name: Observe
planned_ops.summary: Ingest and normalize authorized operational data.

planned_ops.name: Shadow
planned_ops.summary: Seal a counterfactual recommendation at a decision point.

planned_ops.name: Dispatch / Call-Fit
planned_ops.summary: Score eligible Vans; recommend assignment without executing unless authorized.

planned_ops.name: Estimate / quote-from-field
planned_ops.summary: Combine notes, media, parts, difficulty, warranty, and pricebook into a proposed package.

planned_ops.name: Work order / call ledger
planned_ops.summary: Append Chain B events: arrival, media, diagnosis, parts, quote, repair.

planned_ops.name: Inspection / visual QA
planned_ops.summary: Before/during/after media scoring as review evidence, not accusation.

planned_ops.name: Closeout / settlement
planned_ops.summary: Settle predicted vs actual; write receipts; rebase the remaining day.

planned_ops.name: Human override
planned_ops.summary: Record Chain C: who, when, why, replacement, downstream effect.

planned_ops.name: Demand-aware schedule
planned_ops.summary: Booking blocks, first-call/midday protection, emergency insertion (v0.8).

planned_ops.name: Human-review report
planned_ops.summary: Generate a reviewable analysis with mandatory report metadata (v0.7).
